Documentation passages:

[data-1] Active workspaces
Workspace data is kept for as long as the subscription is active.

[pricing-5] Changing plans
Upgrades take effect immediately, and the price difference for the rest of the billing period is charged on a prorated basis. Downgrades take effect at the next billing date; until then the workspace keeps the features of its current plan.

[refunds-3] How to request a refund
A billing admin requests a refund from Settings > Billing > Request refund. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.

[refunds-5] Outages
Downtime is compensated with service credits under the service level agreement, not with refunds.
